propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took twenty-two releases of the online banking channel through the go-live weekend into the live channel between 2022 and 2025, holding the release calendar and the go-live checklist throughout.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the release calendar document the go-lives and the checklist.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the post-release watch with operations on each go-live weekend and called two rollbacks when the login-journey error rate rose above the agreed threshold, both recorded in the change records.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the watch and the rollbacks.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prepared every release through the change advisory board with a readiness review and recorded residual risks and hand-over conditions in the release closure notes.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the closure notes document the readiness reviews and the closure notes.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the go-lives, the calendar and checklist, the rollbacks and the closure notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: The go-lives, the post-release watch and the rollbacks are documented in the resume and the change records; the coordinator years are shown separately from the release manager years.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the change advisory board references of the two rollback releases to confirm the dates.
